orchestration_result.final_recommendation: The services and works proposals are outside the mandate, thus these budget allocations must be rejected. For supplies, although the proposal includes lots and competitive procedures for €3 million, it exceeds the EU threshold of €221K for supply contracts and the 60% lot share. This proposal must also be rejected due to out-of-scope services and works. A new procurement process should be initiated for services and works, ensuring compliance with the EU mandatory thresholds and regulations.
